content_metadata.description: The metadata for the content associated with the requested reads (opinions).

read_ids_not_found.description: The list of read (opinion) IDs that were not found.

answer_class.description: The label class within the answer (correct annotation, combined opinion, or labeler opinion).

is_correct.description: Whether the answer includes the class. Included for classification tasks only.

geometries.description: The segmentation for the answer class in WKT format. Included for contour segmentation tasks only.

mask.description: A pre-signed URL to the segmentation for the answer class in mask (TIFF binary array) format. Included for mask segmentation tasks only.

ranges.description: The integer ranges for the answer class. Included for range tasks only.

entities.description: The entities for the answer class. Included for NER tasks only.

freetexts.description: An array of freetexts with one entry (array or null) per finding.

items.description: An array of freetexts for one specific finding. May contain 0, 1, or multiple text entries.

origin.description: An identifier for the file origin of the content.

series.description: An identifier for the series that the content belongs to.

series_index.description: The index of the content within the series (if any) that it belongs to.

dicom_study_uid.description: The DICOM study UID of the content.

dicom_series_uid.description: The DICOM series UID of the content.

dicom_instance_uid.description: The DICOM instance UID of the content.

qscore.description: The confidence level of the user read (opinion).

frames.description: The frames of the read (opinion): the primary target frame, plus one entry per context document (multi-document annotation topics only) carrying a class-agnostic finding instead of a per-label-class user_opinion.

content_id.description: An identifier for the content associated with the frame.

user_opinion.description: The portion of the read (opinion) annotation for the frame. Present on the target frame's entry only.

categories.description: The category tags assigned to this document's asset. Present on context-document entries only.

freetexts.description: The finding freetext recorded on this context document. Present on context-document entries only.
